code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    # The uniform separators divide the board into independent panels.
    rb=[0]+[i+1 for i in rs]; re=rs+[h]
    cb=[0]+[j+1 for j in cs]; ce=cs+[w]
    from collections import Counter
    vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in rs and j not in cs]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=next((v for v in set(vals) if v!=bg),bg)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[i][j]==marker for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d))>=2 else bg for c,d in zip(cb,ce)] for a,b in zip(rb,re)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
# Test grid produces the solved output.
exec(compile(code,p,'exec'),globals())
print(transform(grid))
